name: Weaviate Agent Skills
summary: Official BSD-3-Clause Agent Skills pack from Weaviate B.V. for collections, query, import, Query Agent and cookbook workflows.
description: weaviate/agent-skills is the official Agent Skills repository from Weaviate B.V. Official LICENSE is the BSD 3-Clause License, Copyright (c) 2020-2026 Weaviate B.V. The repository is not archived; created 2026-02-05 and last pushed 2026-11-09T14:47:18Z (2026-11-09 15:47:18 Europe/Stockholm). Official README Available Skills: Create Collections; Explore Collections (Aggregation, Metadata, Schema); Query Collections (Keyword-, Vector-, Hybrid Search, with filter support); Import Data (supports multi-vector and PDF ingestion); and Query Agent. Official Cookbooks: Multimodal PDF Ingestion; Data Explorer; Retrieval Augmented Generation (Basic, Advanced, Agentic); Agents; Query Agent Chatbot; and Frontend Interface (optional). Official security note: the scripts and cookbooks rely on some widely adopted third-party packages; Weaviate is not responsible for the security of third-party components, as new vulnerabilities may arise at any time; the user should run their own security scans before executing any code and review packages flagged for known issues. This review did not run or install the skills. Documented `npx skills add weaviate/agent-skills` and plugin installs were not executed. Weaviate Cloud usage is separate and was not purchased. This pack is distinct from the already catalogued weaviate entry.

agent_access.notes: Public BSD-3-Clause GitHub pack. No hosted MCP endpoint is documented on this repository. Official README warns that third-party packages should be scanned before execution; documented npx and plugin installs were not run. Weaviate Cloud usage is separate and was not purchased.
